lines.text_source: [14][01][01]"That armor we wear[01]to protect us from[02]the hex is really[01]heavy![02]Walking around in it[01]all day makes you[01]real hungry!"
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: [14][01][01]"A armadura que a gente usa pra se proteger da maldição é bem pesada![02]Ficar andando nela o dia todo da muita fome!"

lines.text_source: [14][02][02]"Uhhh...I don't feel[01]so good...[02]Maybe the hex got[01]to me..."
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: [14][02][02]"Uhhh...nao estou me sentindo bem...[02]Talvez a maldição tenha me atingido..."
lines.risk_notes: hex effects on body; symptom of danger

lines.text_source: [14][03][03]"See that fellow[01]standing there, in[01]front of the pot?[02]That's our boss,[01]Tahb."
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: [14][03][03]"Ve aquele sujeito ali parado, na frente do caldeirão? Aquele [02]é nosso chefe, o Tahb."

lines.text_source: [14][04][04]"Way I figure it, the[01]hex is like someone[01]talking bad about you.[02]I mean, when someone[01]says something bad,[02]you don't feel too[01]good, right?[02]So a hex is like[01]that, except lots[01]more powerful, see?"
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: [14][04][04]"Pela minha conta, a maldição é tipo alguém falando mal de voce.[02]Quer dizer, quando alguém diz algo ruim, voce nao se sente bem, ne? [02]Pois é, a maldição é assim, so que muito, muito mais potente, entende?"
lines.risk_notes: game mechanic explanation; must be clear

lines.text_source: [14][05][05]"The hex the Empire[01]makes is like this[01]black mist...[02]And there's all sorts[01]of nasty stuff like[02]wraiths and specters[01]inside of it...[02]Even the smallest[01]exposure to it[02]without protection[01]is lethal!"
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: [14][05][05]"A maldição que o Império faz é tipo uma neblina preta...[02]E tem um monte de coisa desagradavel dentro dela, tipo espectros e assombracoes...[02]Até a menor exposição sem proteção é letal!"
lines.risk_notes: critical lore about Empire hex, wraiths, and lethal exposure; world-building

lines.text_source: [14][06][06]"This ain't a[01]place for women[01]and children...[02]Don't you know it's[01]been hexed!?
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: [14][06][06]"Isso nao é lugar pra mulher e crianca...[02]Voce nao sabe que foi amaldiçoado!?

lines.text_source: [0C][04][14][C1]@"We need to get[01]through Chamba.[02]Is there any way we[01]can do that before[01]the hex disappears?"
lines.speaker: Nina
lines.intent: seeking passage through Chamba before hex clears
lines.base_translation: [0C][04][14][C1]@"Precisamos atravessar Chamba.[02]Tem alguma forma da gente fazer isso antes da maldição desaparecer?"
lines.risk_notes: Nina voice: firm leadership, not coldly formal; preserve warmth beneath authority

lines.text_source: [0C][04][14][C1]@"So all we need is a[01]guide, then?"[0B][0B][0B][15][12]
lines.speaker: Nina
lines.base_translation: [0C][04][14][C1]@"Entao so precisamos[01]de um guia?"[0B][0B][0B][15][12]

lines.text_source: [14][04][04]"You want to go[01]through the hex?[01]Without any armor!?[02]Are you kidding!? You[01]wouldn't last five[01]seconds in there!"
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: [14][04][04]"Voce quer atravessar a maldição sem armadura!?[02]Nao é serio!? Voce nao duraria nem cinco segundos!"

lines.text_source: [14][05][05]"Well, there are some[01]places where the hex[02]is getting thin and[01]wearing off...[02]Nah, forget it--it's[01]too dangerous!"
lines.speaker: npc
lines.intent: suggesting risky option then backing away
lines.base_translation: [14][05][05]"Bom, tem uns lugares onde a maldição ta enfraquecendo...[02]Nao, esquece--é muito perigoso!"

lines.text_source: [14][06][06]"You want me to take[01]you through the hex?[02]Humph! You don't know[01]it like I do...[02]If you did, you'd[01]know better than to[01]even ask."
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: [14][06][06]"Voce quer que eu te leve atraves da maldição?[02]Hmph! Voce nao conhece como eu...[02]Se conhecesse, seria mais inteligente que pedir."

lines.text_source: [14][07][07]"Everyone is all out[01]working.[02][19]
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: [14][07][07]"Todo mundo ta trabalhando.[02][19]

lines.text_source: [14][04][04]"What!? You're going[01]through with it!?[02]All right...It's your[01]choice, but don't say[01]I didn't warn you."
lines.speaker: npc
lines.intent: giving final warning before party departs
lines.base_translation: [14][04][04]"O que!? Voce vai mesmo!?[02]Tudo bem...é sua escolha, mas nao diga que nao avisei."

lines.text_source: [14][04][04]"They're your[01]responsibility,[01][04][05].[02]You'd better take[01]good care of them!"
lines.speaker: npc
lines.intent: placing duty of care on player
lines.base_translation: [14][04][04]"Eles sao responsabilidade sua, [04][05].[02]Cuide bem deles!"

lines.text_source: [14][05][05]"Any exposure to the[01]mist is dangerous...[02]It can poison you, or[01]do funny things to[01]your head...[02]And sometimes, it'll[01]just plain kill you![02]No matter what you[01]do, stay away from[01]the mist!"
lines.speaker: npc
lines.intent: final detailed warnings about hex dangers
lines.base_translation: [14][05][05]"Qualquer exposição à neblina é perigosa...[02]Pode te envenenar, ou fazer coisas estranhas com sua mente...[02]E às vezes, simplesmente te mata![02]Nao importa o que voce faca, fique longe da neblina!"
lines.risk_notes: critical game mechanic warning; must be clear and persuasive

lines.text_source: [14][05][05]"Just because you're[01]safe, [04][05], don't[01]forget they're not.[02]Make sure you protect[01]them--got it?"
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: [14][05][05]"So porque voce está seguro, [04][05], nao esqueca que eles nao estao.[02]Certifique-se de protege-los--entendeu?"

lines.text_source: [14][06][06]"You're going to have[01][04][05] guide you[01]through the mist!?[02]You must be pretty[01]brave to try[01]something like that!"
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: [14][06][06]"Voce vai deixar [04][05] guiar voce atraves da neblina!?[02]Voce deve ser bem bravo pra tentar isso!"

lines.text_source: [14][06][06]"I always knew you[01]were a funny one...[02]Figures you'd take[01]this job!"
lines.speaker: npc
lines.intent: wry acknowledgment of player's unusual nature
lines.base_translation: [14][06][06]"Sempre soube que voce era estranho...[02]Faz sentido que pegasse esse trabalho!"

lines.text_source: [14][08][08]"The center of[01]Chamba is pretty[01]confusing...[02]Make sure you don't[01]get lost."
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: [14][08][08]"O centro de Chamba é bem confuso...[02]Certifique-se de nao se perder."

lines.text_source: [14][08][08]"Just make sure you[01]get them out alive,[01]eh [04][05]?"
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: [14][08][08]"So certifique-se de tira-los daqui vivos, ta bom [04][05]?"

lines.text_source: "If you want to sleep, I[01]can let you use one of[01]these beds."[12][86][0C][93]Rest[01]Diary[01]Never mind
lines.speaker: system
lines.base_translation: "Se voce quer dormir, posso deixar voce usar uma dessas camas."[12][86][0C][93]Descansar[01]Diario[01]Nao fazer nada

lines.text_source: [14][01][01]"Everyone's out[01]working.[02]Me? I, uh...[0B]I'm[01]sick."
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: [14][01][01]"Todo mundo ta trabalhando.[02]Eu? Eu, uh...[0B]Estou doente."
lines.risk_notes: hex sickness spreading to workers; foreshadows danger

lines.text_source: [14][08][08]"Not working as hard[01]as I used to...[02]Just don't have the[01]energy anymore.[02]It must be the hex...[01]Yeah, that's it--it's[01]gotta be the hex!"
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: [14][08][08]"Nao estou trabalhando tao duro quanto antes...[02]So nao tenho energia mais.[02]Deve ser a maldição... É isso mesmo--tem que ser a maldição!"
lines.risk_notes: character rationalization of hex effect; symptom progression

lines.text_source: [14][04][04]"This hex is pretty[01]potent...Never seen[01]one like it before.[02]I mean, we were able[01]to clean up Synesta[01]in no time at all!"
lines.speaker: npc
lines.intent: noting hex potency compared to previous work
lines.base_translation: [14][04][04]"Essa maldição é bem potente...Nunca vi uma igual.[02]Quer dizer, a gente conseguiu limpar Synesta rapidinho!"
lines.risk_notes: mentions Synesta cleanup (lore reference); establishes Empire's power

lines.text_source: [14][01][01]"All right, all[01]right, [04][05]...[02]I'll go to work once[01]I finish eating this,[01]OK?"
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: [14][01][01]"Tudo bem, tudo bem, [04][05]...[02]Eu vou trabalhar assim que terminar de comer isso, ok?"

lines.text_source: [14][04][04]"Come to think of[01]it...[02]You weren't with us[01]when we cleaned up[01]Synesta, were you?"
lines.speaker: npc
lines.intent: recalling player absence during past mission
lines.base_translation: [14][04][04]"Pensando bem...[02]Voce nao estava com a gente quando limpamos Synesta, estava?"

lines.text_source: [14][08][08]"Took you a while to[01]get back, eh [04][05]?[02]Did you get lost in[01]there?"
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: [14][08][08]"Demorou pra voltar, ne [04][05]?[02]Voce se perdeu la dentro?"

lines.text_source: [14][03][03]"Just you wait and[01]see--we'll have this[02]place cleaned up any[01]day now...It'll look[01]just like Synesta!"
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: [14][03][03]"Só aguarde e veja--a gente vai limpar esse lugar em breve.[02]Va parecer igual Synesta!"

lines.text_source: [14][09][09]"What're we going to[01]do with ourselves[01]once we finish here?"[02][14][FF][FF][14][8A]J"Well, they said if[01]another war starts,[02]they'll give us a[01]call."
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: [14][09][09]"O que a gente vai fazer com a gente mesmo quando terminar aqui?"[02][14][FF][FF][14][8A]J"Bom, eles disseram que se outra guerra começar,[02]eles vao nos chamar."
